title: HEART Score for Major Cardiac Events
sources: Six AJ et al. Neth Heart J 2008 (original derivation)
Mahler SA et al. Circ Cardiovasc Qual Outcomes 2015 (HEART Pathway RCT)
Fifth Universal Definition of MI (2026) — sex-specific troponin URL

changelog.change: Added a note: per the Fifth Universal Definition of MI (2026), the troponin 'normal limit' is the SEX-SPECIFIC 99th-percentile URL. Scoring unchanged.

purpose: Risk-stratifies undifferentiated chest pain for 6-week major adverse cardiac events (MACE); drives admit vs. discharge.

items.label: Risk factors (HTN, hyperlipidemia, DM, obesity, smoking, family hx, atherosclerotic disease)

options.label: ≥ 3 risk factors, or known atherosclerotic disease

notes: The troponin 'normal limit' is the assay's SEX-SPECIFIC 99th-percentile upper reference limit (Fifth Universal Definition of MI, 2026) — a single uniform cutoff under-recognises myocardial injury in women.
buildNote: Standard, stable score. Second-source check against MDCalc before go-live per Calculator_Logic_Build_Spec.md.
